details:
So I was messing around with a few worlds getting some photos for my friends and I noticed that both *expression-activated props* and *gesture-activated props* weren't showing up on the vrchat camera. This wasn't noticed before but I believe it started on the beta and made its way to the live release. A little testing and it seems to only be affecting old avatars. It doesn't load assets on SDK 2.0 avatars anymore. 

An avatar example is the one on the right in this image: https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1145363395953045585/1145641151601315850/VRChat_2023-08-28_01-47-53.570_3840x2160.png?ex=652cf8f7&is=651a83f7&hm=e3bffd1c1e40fb35df96a4b5c064425b14cc75939a7c813b9f87dd34bc217a68&=&width=1202&height=676

In the camera, the flames and hammer no longer render, as shown here: https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1037571521624936499/1159712692123209808/image.png?ex=6532059c&is=651f909c&hm=a83a79f9ae4fe091278ea253579d40bee27150d93ae3007dc85c637c119523f2&

More testing needs to be done but for now this is a massive issue for me because it limits what I can do with the camera.

Note: it could also affect SDK 3.0 avatars. I noticed with one of those that a prop didn't get rendered until i reloaded the avatar with the camera active.
title: Camera broken?
